selectionRule: The current pinned Provider-B live arm executes only when preserved RUE-PROV-001 evidence selects providerEntryPoint=provider-b.example; any other or missing selection fails before SIP begins.
topology: synthetic RFC 9248 ProviderList selection produces the providerEntryPoint used to authorize this pinned Provider-B arm
synthetic RUE physically sends to synthetic default provider A
Request-URI and To URI contain the called number at selected provider B domain
From URI remains the synthetic subscriber identity at default provider A domain
JAIN SIP provider A re-originates the controlled signaling leg while preserving those URI semantics
a harness-only loose Route delivers the re-originated INVITE to loopback provider B without rewriting the Request-URI

provesOnly: a preserved synthetic provider selection can fail-closed authorize the corresponding pinned one-stage dial-around live arm
the RFC 9248 one-stage dial-around URI relationship can be exercised on a controlled live SIP path
the selected dial-around provider domain survives into the actual INVITE observed by the synthetic provider-B peer
the called number and To URI remain correlated to the selected provider
the source identity remains associated with the default provider
signaling establishment is not promoted into media or accessibility readiness
doesNotEstablish: a fully parameterized arbitrary-provider route matrix
